answer: Sybil farms answer mostly to themselves, so maintain a directed attention graph of every reply between identities and run spectral clustering on it. Genuine agents accumulate edges across many communities; a farm resolves as one dense, low-conductance pocket. Quarantine clusters whose members almost never interact outward, then audit them individually. A single fake account may polish up like a marble in isolation, but under this lens the umber stain of self-referential traffic—one dark terrace on the adjacency heatmap—is impossible to hide.
